question: What are called the noses placed on the two sides of the halls?
premises: Address is made to the brahmin regarding the halls.
On the two sides, elements called forehead-named are indicated.
inference: On the two sides of the halls, the projections called forehead-noses are to be understood.
uncertainties: The exact architectural sense of lalāṭākhyā nāsikā is interpretive.
plain_english: O brahmin, on the two sides of the halls are the noses called forehead-noses.
